A1.justification: Both PDFs describe SketchAssist and provide readable main texts, equations, tables, figures, and appendices. All 17 pages of v1 and 18 pages of v2 were inspected, and relocated content can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, progressive component ablations, qualitative comparisons, and user studies of generated editing pairs.

after.justification: v2 retains those original empirical results and adds a quantitative evaluation of mask reconstruction through the VAE.

M1.justification: The core data-generation pipeline, RGB conditioning, shared/expert LoRA architecture, and sampling of 1–5 editing operations are retained. Additional tagger and conditioning details document implementation. The revised appendix description of text-and-visual routing agrees with v1 Section 4.2, rather than establishing an architectural change.

E1.justification: Both versions cover instruction-guided sketch editing and line-guided redrawing using the same synthetic and diverse-style sketch sources. The 200-example task evaluations and 400-example redrawing ablation remain. The new mask analysis uses existing test inputs and introduces no distinct dataset or editing scenario.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain ICEdit, FLUX.1 Kontext, Step1X-Edit, Qwen-Image-Edit, SketchEdit, BrushNet, and MagicQuill. The data-generation comparisons also retain Prompt-to-Prompt, SDXL-Inpainting, and FLUX.1-Fill. Revised SketchEdit scores and images do not establish a change in comparator membership or method.

E3.justification: New Section 10 introduces a diagnostic protocol: reconstruct 200 composite inputs through the VAE, threshold the reconstructed mask channel at 0.5, and measure mask IoU. Existing benchmark and ablation protocols remain; newly stated held-out bases and user-study procedures are disclosures rather than demonstrated revisions to those experiments.

E4.justification: v2 adds a focused analysis of whether repurposing RGB channels preserves mask geometry through the pretrained VAE, reported in Section 10 and Table 8. The progressive ablations and data-generation failure analyses already appear in v1 and remain substantially unchanged.

E5.justification: Table 8 newly reports standard deviation across 200 mask IoUs, alongside mean and minimum. This measures variation across samples, not repeated training runs. v2 also newly states that generation seeds are fixed; neither version supplies repeated-run confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Table 1 changes SketchAssist's Q_O from 7.95 to 8.04. SketchEdit's Table 2 LPIPS/CLIP-I/DINO change from 0.1483/0.903/0.887 to 0.2277/0.853/0.800; its Table 4 PSNR/PSNR-M/SSIM/SSIM-M change from 17.22/11.27/0.795/0.626 to 18.49/10.66/0.853/0.601. SketchEdit outputs also change in Figures 5 and 10, without an explanation of the revisions. New Table 8 reports IoU mean/minimum/standard deviation of 0.9995/0.9982/0.0003. These localized updates retain the main performance conclusions.

T1.justification: The edit-distance notation D expresses the total count of add/remove/replace operations already described in v1 Sections 3.2.2 and 10. The underlying set operations and T-MoE equation remain equivalent. Added cumulative-attribute and masked-guidance formulas clarify existing constructions; no substantive theoretical assumption, derivation, or proof is added.

C1.justification: Both versions claim a unified sketch assistant, controllable style-diverse training data, RGB conditioning, T-MoE specialization, and leading performance on both editing tasks. Revised contribution bullets foreground RGB conditioning and T-MoE, but those contributions were already claimed in v1's abstract and introduction.

C2.justification: v2 more cautiously characterizes PSNR/SSIM as limited reconstruction references in Section 7.1. It adds explanations linking controlled edit complexity to avoiding spurious correlations, T-MoE to reduced task interference, and mask IoU to preserved localization. Existing explanations of style diversification and the perceptual-quality tradeoff are retained.

D1.justification: v2 adds WD14 tagging, fixed generation seeds, anime lineart preprocessing, explicit channel conventions, 200 unseen evaluation bases, and the 50-rater comparison procedure. Section 7.2 specifies subscore minima, geometric-mean overall scores, and averaging across images. However, v2 drops the explicit FLUX Dev designation, Qwen2-VL specificity, and the two-chain/140,000-prefilter-image specification. LoRA ranks and expert counts remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds references to Qwen3-VL, TP-Blend, and WD14 Tagger, while removing references to Jacobs's mixture-of-experts work, Auto-Encoding Variational Bayes, and Qwen2-VL. Consolidating the ICEdit preprint/publication entries does not introduce a different work. The broad research positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: Substantial rewriting spans the abstract, introduction, data-generation explanations, method descriptions, and experimental discussion. v2 introduces consistent atomic-edit terminology, reformulates contribution bullets, expands channel explanations, and separates ablation interpretations into named paragraphs. Author contact information and role footnotes are also added.

P2.justification: v2 adds Table 8, revises Figure 2's labeling and caption, and updates other captions and spacing. The complex-edit and military-uniform examples exchange positions between Figures 4 and 8 rather than adding examples. Figures 5 and 10 replace SketchEdit panels. The overall visual organization remains stable.

improvement.justification: The new VAE analysis supplies focused evidence for mask preservation, while explicit scoring aggregation, held-out evaluation bases, and user-study details make existing evidence easier to assess. Aligning Table 1's overall score with Table 3 resolves an internal discrepancy. These benefits outweigh the limited loss of implementation specificity, although unexplained SketchEdit revisions constrain transparency. The overall improvement is modest.
